title: ZYFJDCD P1 Derived-Only Analysis Pack
description: Derived-only analysis pack for an OCR-derived corpus from the 2nd edition of Zhongyi Fangji Da Cidian. The archive contains benchmark indices, evaluation tables, figure assets, provenance mappings, and public-safe verification scripts. It does not redistribute the full OCR-derived book text.
